# Post-graduation work permit eligibility (archived 2023 snapshot)
> MOCK FIXTURE — not real policy. For development only.

Graduates of any eligible program at a designated learning institution may apply; there is no field-of-study requirement [1].
Applications must be submitted within 180 days of receiving final marks [1].
